solution_text: Step 1: Add the units digits: 4 + 3 = 7. Step 2: Add the tens digits: 3 + 2 = 5. Answer: 57.

solution_mathml: <math xmlns='http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML'><mrow><mtext>Step 1: Subtract the units digits: </mtext><mn>8</mn><mtext> - </mtext><mn>5</mn><mtext> = </mtext><mn>3</mn><mtext>.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Step 2: Subtract the tens digits: </mtext><mn>5</mn><mtext> - </mtext><mn>2</mn><mtext> = </mtext><mn>3</mn><mtext>.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Answer: </mtext><mn>33</mn><mtext>.</mtext></mrow></math>
solution_text: Step 1: Subtract the units digits: 8 - 5 = 3. Step 2: Subtract the tens digits: 5 - 2 = 3. Answer: 33.

subject: Math
question_mathml: <math xmlns='http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML'><mtext>A baker made </mtext><mn>45</mn><mtext> cookies. He sold </mtext><mn>20</mn><mtext> of them. How many cookies are left?</mtext></math>
solution_mathml: <math xmlns='http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML'><mrow><mtext>Step 1: To find out how many cookies are left, subtract the number sold from the number made: </mtext><mn>45</mn><mtext> - </mtext><mn>20</mn><mtext>.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Step 2: Subtract the units: </mtext><mn>5</mn><mtext> - </mtext><mn>0</mn><mtext> = </mtext><mn>5</mn><mtext>.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Step 3: Subtract the tens: </mtext><mn>4</mn><mtext> - </mtext><mn>2</mn><mtext> = </mtext><mn>2</mn><mtext>.</mtext></mrow><mrow><mtext>Answer: </mtext><mn>25</mn><mtext>.</mtext></mrow></math>
question_text: A baker made 45 cookies. He sold 20 of them. How many cookies are left?
solution_text: Step 1: To find out how many cookies are left, subtract the number sold from the number made: 45 - 20. Step 2: Subtract the units: 5 - 0 = 5. Step 3: Subtract the tens: 4 - 2 = 2. Answer: 25.
